_comment: Default commits resolved when no explicit branch/hash is supplied. Update these after verifying a build passes with a newer commit.

_provenance.susfs_android15-6.6_KSU: simonpunk/susfs4ksu gki-android15-6.6 -> f98f0822 (2026-11-15), SUSFS_VERSION 'v2.4.0' read from kernel_patches/include/linux/susfs.h at that ref.
_provenance.susfs_android15-6.6_KSUN: be7b7ef4 = SUSFS v2.2.0, the last revision whose KSUN fix-patch set actually matches a KernelSU-Next tree. v2.4.0 + KSUN leaves rejects in kernel/core/init.c, kernel/feature/sucompat.c, kernel/supercall/dispatch.c and others (CI run 44007359941), so KSUN stays on v2.2.0 until an upstream fix set lands.
_provenance.ksu_main: tiann/KernelSU main f49be695 (2026-11-17, 'kernel: Use the first match for exact symbol lookup (#3999)'). Verified: SUSFS v2.4.0's 10_enable_susfs_for_ksu.patch (106 hunks, 32 files) applies with ZERO rejects at this commit.
_provenance.ksu_main_evidence: Scanned 60 commits of tiann/KernelSU main with a hard-reset worktree per candidate. Only two are clean: f49be695 (newest, 2026-11-17) and 64833c00 (2026-11-14, the commit the SUSFS v2.4.0 message names as its sync point). Everything older fails 4-6 hunks because the patch target was restructured (offsets up to -138 lines). Pinning 64833c00 would also work but is 3 days stale for no benefit.
_provenance.ksun_dev: KernelSU-Next dev 7ccf6147 is carried only because KSUN still builds against SUSFS v2.2.0; it is NOT validated against v2.4.0.
_provenance.why_paired: The susfs pins are keyed per KSU variant because each flavour tracks the susfs sync at a different point. A SUSFS revision and a KernelSU revision must agree on the selinux_hide dispatch shape and on the file layout the enable patch expects.
_provenance.history: Previously both variants were pinned at SUSFS v2.2.0 (KSU=937215c / KSUN=be7b7ef). This revision moves only KSU to v2.4.0, because that is the pairing that was proven by an actual patch application rather than by reading a commit message.
